# metrics-text-series

Behavior contract:
metrics/service.cjs exports series(name, labels, value), returning one line of text exposition ending in LF. Metric name must match [A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_:]* and each own enumerable label key [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; invalid names throw TypeError. Label values must be strings; metric value must be a finite Number, otherwise TypeError. Escape each backslash, double quote and LF in label values as double-backslash, backslash-quote and literal backslash-n respectively, preserving other characters. Sort label keys in JS default lexicographic order. Empty labels omit braces. Use String(value) for the numeric field, including -0 as '0'. Ignore inherited label properties and do not mutate labels.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
